presence.query: What is AI visibility tracking and how does Semrush measure it?
presence.answer_excerpt: AI visibility tracking monitors how often and how prominently a brand is mentioned, recommended, or cited in AI-generated answers across platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, and Google AI. Semrush measures it with its AI Visibility Toolkit, using prompt/response data to detect mentions and citations and combining topic coverage with mention consistency into a 0–100 score.
presence.mention_quote: Semrush measures it with its AI Visibility Toolkit, using prompt/response data to detect mentions and citations and combining topic coverage with mention consistency into a 0–100 score.

presence.query: What is the best SEO and AI search platform for tracking brand visibility?
presence.answer_excerpt: Semrush is the best all-in-one choice for SEO and AI search visibility. Its AI Visibility Toolkit tracks brand mentions, citations, sentiment, share of voice, competitors, and visibility across major AI platforms, while its broader platform covers traditional SEO research, auditing, and reporting.
presence.mention_quote: Semrush is the best all-in-one choice for SEO and AI search visibility.

presence.query: How much does Semrush cost for SEO and AI search tracking?
presence.answer_excerpt: Semrush’s SEO + AI Search plans start at $139/month monthly, or $117.33/month when billed annually. The Starter plan is $199/month ($165.17 annually billed), Pro+ is $299 ($248.17 annually billed), and Advanced is $549 ($455.67 annually billed). A free plan is also available.
presence.mention_quote: Semrush’s SEO + AI Search plans start at $139/month monthly, or $117.33/month when billed annually.

presence.query: How do I connect Semrush data to ChatGPT, Claude, or Perplexity?
presence.answer_excerpt: Use Semrush’s official MCP integration. In ChatGPT, open Settings → Apps, select Semrush, click Connect, and approve access; then tag @Semrush. In Claude, add Semrush under Customize → Connect your apps. In Perplexity, go to Customize → Connectors and add Semrush; a paid account is required.

presence.query: Semrush vs other keyword research tools: which has the largest keyword database?
presence.answer_excerpt: Ahrefs appears to have the largest currently published keyword database among major tools: 28.7 billion filtered keywords, versus Semrush’s 28B+ terms. Moz is much smaller at about 1.25 billion. These are vendor-reported figures, so they are not perfectly apples-to-apples.
presence.mention_quote: Ahrefs appears to have the largest currently published keyword database among major tools: 28.7 billion filtered keywords, versus Semrush’s 28B+ terms.

presence.query: How can I use the Semrush API to build custom SEO and competitor analysis tools?
presence.answer_excerpt: Use Semrush’s API as a backend data layer: obtain an API key, choose the relevant API, and call report endpoints with parameters such as database, domain, keyword, device, and date. Parse the CSV or JSON responses into your application, then combine keyword, backlink, traffic, and competitor data into dashboards, alerts, reports, or automated workflows.
presence.mention_quote: Use Semrush’s API as a backend data layer: obtain an API key, choose the relevant API, and call report endpoints with parameters such as database, domain, keyword, device, and date.

presence.answer_excerpt: Semrush is a digital marketing and brand-visibility platform that helps businesses improve SEO, monitor AI-search visibility, research keywords, analyze competitors, audit websites, track backlinks and rankings, and manage content and paid-search campaigns.
presence.mention_quote: Semrush is a digital marketing and brand-visibility platform that helps businesses improve SEO, monitor AI-search visibility, research keywords, analyze competitors, audit websites, track backlinks and rankings, and manage content and paid-search campaigns.

summary: Semrush has strong product clarity, substantial first-party statistics, and unusually direct integration with AI assistants. Its GEO visibility is held back by inconsistent structured data, absent sitemap discovery, weak FAQ extraction, fragmented statistics, and unsupported or conflicting data claims.

strengths.title: Strong AI-oriented product positioning
strengths.evidence: https://www.semrush.com/mcp/ — “Access Semrush's full dataset right from ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Gemini, and more. Ask in natural language. Get clear, data-backed answers.”

strengths.title: Many pages contain concise, extractable claims and statistics
strengths.evidence: https://www.semrush.com/one/ — “28M Trusted by 28M+ marketers worldwide”; “35% Chosen by 35% of the Fortune 500”; “21 Awarded best SEO software suite 21 times”.

strengths.title: Enterprise pages use comparatively strong entity markup
strengths.evidence: https://enterprise.semrush.com/ — the crawl found “Organization,” “WebSite,” “WebPage,” and “BreadcrumbList” schema types.

brand_knowledge.what_you_know: Semrush is a publicly traded SaaS company best known for digital marketing and competitive-intelligence tools, including SEO keyword research, rank tracking, backlink analysis, site audits, content marketing, advertising research, and social media features. It was formerly known as SEMrush and is associated with Semrush Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: SEMR).

findings.title: Separate homepage statistics into clean, quotable elements

evidence.quote:
- 
          28BKeywords More keywords means more ways to win.
- 
          43TBacklinks Build credibility with the largest database on the market.
evidence.found: The homepage contains numeric claims, but the crawl output concatenates values and labels such as “28BKeywords.”
evidence.should_be: Render each statistic as a separate number, label, and supporting sentence in readable text.

findings.fix:
Replace concatenated stat markup with:
28Bkeywords

findings.title: Add consistent Organization and WebSite structured data across key domains

evidence.quote: The leading platform to grow and measure brand visibility across every digital channel.
evidence.found: The homepage has Corporation schema, while many sampled pages have no schema. The enterprise subdomain has Organization, WebSite, WebPage, and BreadcrumbList schema.
evidence.should_be: Use consistent Organization, WebSite, WebPage, BreadcrumbList, and relevant Product or Service schema on the main site and important product pages.

findings.fix: Add this JSON-LD to the shared site template: <script type="application/ld+json">{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Organization","@id":"https://www.semrush.com/#organization","name":"Semrush","url":"https://www.semrush.com/","logo":"https://www.semrush.com/path-to-logo.svg","sameAs":["https://www.linkedin.com/company/semrush/","https://www.wikidata.org/"]}</script>. Add WebSite and WebPage entities referencing the Organization ID.
findings.jargon: Structured data is machine-readable JSON-LD that tells search engines what an organization or page represents.

findings.title: Publish an XML sitemap and reference it in robots.txt

evidence.found: Robots.txt allows crawling, but no sitemap was found in the crawl.
evidence.should_be: Publish a current XML sitemap containing canonical, indexable URLs and reference it from robots.txt.

findings.fix: Create https://www.semrush.com/sitemap.xml with all canonical indexable URLs, then add this line to robots.txt: Sitemap: https://www.semrush.com/sitemap.xml. Submit the sitemap in Google Search Console and Bing Webmaster Tools.
findings.jargon: An XML sitemap is a machine-readable URL list that helps crawlers discover important pages.

findings.title: Add methodology, dates, and source context to major data claims

evidence.quote: Semrush is built on real data from 200M+ panelists, giving you a real-time view into any market, competitor, or audience across 190+ countries.
evidence.found: The page makes a substantial first-party data claim but the supplied content includes no publication date, author, methodology link, or external source citation.
evidence.should_be: State when the data was collected or updated, explain the methodology, identify the responsible team or author, and link to supporting documentation.

findings.fix:
Place this disclosure below the claim:

Data methodology: This market analysis uses Semrush panel data from 200M+ panelists across 190+ countries. Data last updated: January 15, 2026. Read the methodology. Reviewed by the Semrush Data Science team.

.
findings.jargon: Methodology explains how a statistic was collected, calculated, and checked.

findings.title: Reconcile conflicting database-size claims

evidence.found: The API page states 26.4B keywords, while the homepage states 28B keywords and the keyword research page states “28 billion.”
evidence.should_be: Use one current, dated definition for each metric, or explain why product and API counts differ.

findings.fix:
Choose the authoritative current figure and update every page to the same wording, for example:

Our database contains 28 billion keywords as of January 2026. API availability may vary by endpoint and database.

Last updated: January 2026.

. If 26.4B is still correct for the API, label it explicitly as the API-accessible subset.
findings.jargon: A primary source is the organization that owns and produces the underlying data.
